```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(readxl)
library(p8105.datasets)


source("source/mean_and_sd.R")
source("source/sim_mean_sd.R") 
source("source/nsduh_process.R")

source("source/sim_slr.R") 
source("source/birthday.R") 

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d

set.seed(1236)
```

## Mean and sd

```{r}
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30, 3, 1.2)
```

#### keeping track of results 

```{r}
output = vector("list", 1000)

for (i in 1:10000) {
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
}

sim_results = bind_rows(output)
```

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarise(
    emp_m = mean(mean), 
    emp_sd = sd(mean)
  )
```

```{r}
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()
```

## Using tibbles and map instead

```{r}
sim_results_df =
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  )
```


```{r}
sim_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    sample_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    estimate_df = map(sample_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(estimate_df)
```

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    sample_size = str_c("n = ", sample_size),
    sample_size = fct_inorder(sample_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_size, y = mean, fill = sample_size)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

### Looking at number summaries

```{r}
sim_results_df |> 
  pivot_longer(
    mean:sd,
    names_to = "parameter", 
    values_to = "estimate") |> 
  group_by(parameter, sample_size) |> 
  summarize(
    emp_mean = mean(estimate),
    emp_var = var(estimate)) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

# SLR !
Generate once:

```{r}
sim_data = 
    tibble(
      x = rnorm(30, mean = 1, sd = 1),
      y = 2 * x + rnorm(30, 0, 1)
    )
  
  

 sim_data |> 
   ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
   geom_point() +
   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

turned into a function (source/sim_slr.R)

```{r}
sim_slr(30)
```

```{r}
slr_results_df = 
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_slr)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)
```

Is it right
```{r}
slr_results_df |> 
  summarize(
    b0_mean = mean(beta0_hat), 
    b0_se = sd(beta0_hat)
  )
```

results

```{r}
slr_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = beta0_hat, y = beta1_hat, color = beta0_hat)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```



## Birthday Problem

```{r}
birthdays = sample(1:365, size = 5, replace = TRUE)

repeated_birthdays = length(unique(birthdays)) < 5

repeated_birthdays
```

make it a function
run it

```{r}
birthday_repeated(147)
```

a bunch

```{r}
birthday_results_df =
  expand_grid(
    number_of_people = 5:50,
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  )
birthday_results_df
```

visual

```{r}
birthday_results_df |> 
  group_by(number_of_people) |> 
  summarise(prob_of_repeat = mean(repeated)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = prob_of_repeat)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line()
```
